|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Mana-Infused Staff''' is a [[spell]] that [[reservation|reserves]] mana to empower your staff, granting more attack and spell [[block]] chance and less [[mana]] [[cost]] of skills. While active, whenever you block, you deal release a wave of [[lightning damage|lightning]] for a [[duration]] based on your maximum mana. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== {{c|mod|Mana Reservation of this Skill is always 30%}}: Mana-Infused Staff will always reserve 30% [[mana]]. This value cannot be changed with reservation multipliers or efficiency and it cannot be converted to life reservation. Mechanically, the wave is similar to {{il|Wave of Conviction}}. Because the reservation cost is fixed at 30%, it is possible to support this spell with things like {{il|Hextouch Support}} or any number of other support gems without reserving more mana. * '''Skill behavior:''' Mana-Infused Staff produces an advancing circular line of damage, which may only damage an enemy once on pass-through. It will stop on terrain only in places where the terrain makes contact; it is possible for a rock or pillar to split a wave in two and shield anything behind it. * '''Effective range''': The travel distance after which the wave terminates is dictated by two factors: area of effect modifiers, and duration modifiers. Mathematically, the result is multiplicative between the two stats; when applied independently of each other, area of effect will appear to increase the wave's travel speed while duration directly affects range while not changing wave speed. * '''Wave count limit:''' A wave can only be produced once per second. However, there is no limit to how many waves can be active simultaneously. So if duration were to be scaled up enough, it is possible to produce more waves even though the first one hasn't disappeared yet. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Lightning
Damage |c1_header = Deals base Lightning Damage equal to x% of Maximum Mana |c1_pattern_extract = Deals base Lightning Damage equal to (%d+)%% of Maximum Mana |c1_pattern_value = %d%% |c2_abbr = Block
Multiplier |c2_header = Buff grants x% more Chance to Block Attack and Spell Damage |c2_pattern_extract = Buff grants (%d+)%% more Chance to Block Attack and Spell Damage |c2_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Mana-Infused Staff cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Mana-Infused Staff%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Mana-Infused Staff%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Introduced to the game. * Mana-Infused Staff is now offered to the Templar for completing Intruders in Black, and can be purchased from Yeena by the Witch and Shadow. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
